Title: A Day to Remember

Cast

1. Nikhil - 9 years, son
Look: glasses, green shirt, black trousers
2. Sunita - 39 years, mother
Look: pink kurta, a long plait
3. Manoj - 39 years, father
Look: light beard, green T-shirt
4. Siya - 10 years, daughter
Look: green salwar-kurta, short hair

Places

1. The park - green grass, swings, benches
2. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
3. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
4. The main road - a wide road, traffic lights

Scene 1: The park - Day

[Nikhil stands in the park. Sunita stands near him.]

Sunita: "Nikhil, what's the plan today?"

[Nikhil swings on the swing.]

Sunita (excited): "Yes, of course."

[Nikhil goes down the slide.]

Nikhil (surprised): "How beautiful!"

Scene 2: The courtyard - Day

Siya: "What a nice place."

[Nikhil tiptoes across the courtyard.]

Sunita: "What happened?"

[Nikhil coughs.]

Nikhil: "Slowly, take it easy."

[A strong wind starts blowing.]

Nikhil: "I'm ready!"

[Dark clouds gather in the sky.]

Nikhil (happily): "Show me too!"

[Nikhil bumps his head on the door frame and his forehead bleeds.]

Nikhil: "What happened?"

Scene 3: The living room - Day

[Nikhil stands in the living room. Sunita and Manoj stand near him.]

Manoj: "So, here we are!"

[Nikhil talks to his father on the phone.]

Nikhil (happily): "Slowly, take it easy."

[Nikhil types on his laptop.]

Nikhil (gently): "Yes, all right."

Scene 4: The main road - Day

[Nikhil stands on the road. Sunita and Manoj stand near him.]

Manoj: "Let's begin."

[Father drives the car; Mother sits beside him in the front and Nikhil sits in the back seat.]

Sunita (excited): "I'm ready!"

[Nikhil sits in the front passenger seat while Mother drives.]

Nikhil (surprised): "That was fun!"

[The family gets into the car: Father at the wheel, Nikhil in the back.]

Nikhil (gently): "That was such a fun day!"
